Import all tables
```{r import}
library(readxl)

path <- "/Users/divyanshbagla/Desktop/STAT341/Architecture/Truss.xlsx"
na_codes <- c("", "-", "\u2013", "\u2014", "\u2212")

sheet_names <- excel_sheets(path)
truss <- lapply(sheet_names, function(s)
  read_excel(path, sheet = s, na = na_codes, guess_max = 100000,
             .name_repair = if (s == "aisc") "minimal" else "unique")
)
names(truss) <- sheet_names

# ---- aisc: trim, clean headers, drop notes rows, keep needed columns ----
needed <- c("Type", "EDI_Std_Nomenclature", "AISC_Manual_Label",
            "W", "A", "J", "H", "t", "tf", "ro", "rx", "ry",
            "b/tdes", "h/tdes", "D/t", "bf/2tf", "b/t", "h/tw",
            "B", "Ht", "tdes", "OD","Zx","Sx","Ix","Iy","rts",
            "ho","d","Cw")

a <- truss$aisc[, 1:84]
names(a) <- gsub("[[:space:]]+", "_", trimws(names(a)))
a <- a[!is.na(a$Type), ]

missing <- setdiff(needed, names(a))
if (length(missing)) {
  print(names(a))
  stop("aisc is missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
}
a <- a[, needed]
for (col in needed[-(1:3)]) a[[col]] <- as.numeric(a[[col]])
truss$aisc <- a
rm(a)

names(truss)
```

Populate tables (aisc, bar). Creates: aisc columns (t_net, array_name_column, r_min), Bar columns (Length, cos, sin, crossing columns, L_b, EffectiveLength)
```{r populate}
populate_tables <- function(truss) {

  populate_aisc <- function() {

    rename_hss <- function() {
      n_X <- lengths(regmatches(truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature,
                                gregexpr("X", truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature)))
      truss$aisc$Type[truss$aisc$Type == "HSS" & n_X == 2] <<- "Rectangle"
      truss$aisc$Type[truss$aisc$Type == "HSS" & n_X == 1] <<- "Round"
    }

    # database says "W", the Family table says "WShape"
    rename_w <- function() {
      if ("WShape" %in% truss$Family$FamilyName)
        truss$aisc$Type[truss$aisc$Type == "W"] <<- "WShape"
    }

    map_J <- function() {
      truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature_mapL <<- sub("^2(?=L)", "", truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature, perl = TRUE)
      truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature_mapL <<- sub("^([^X]*X[^X]*X[^X]*)X.*$", "\\1",
                                                   truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature_mapL)
      truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature_mapL <<- sub("[^0-9]+$", "", truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature_mapL)

      pos_2L <- which(truss$aisc$Type == "2L")
      pos_L  <- which(truss$aisc$Type == "L")
      idx <- match(truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature_mapL[pos_2L],
                   truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature[pos_L])
      hit <- !is.na(idx)

      truss$aisc$J[pos_2L[hit]] <<- 2 * truss$aisc$J[pos_L[idx[hit]]]
    }

    drop_types <- function() {
      discard <- c("L", "M", "S", "HP", "C", "MC", "MT", "ST")
      truss$aisc <<- truss$aisc[!truss$aisc$Type %in% discard, ]
    }

    add_columns <- function() {
      truss$aisc$t_net <<- NA
      truss$aisc$CostLevel1 <<- NA
      truss$aisc$CostLevel2 <<- NA
      truss$aisc$Fu <<- NA
      truss$aisc$Fy <<- NA
      truss$aisc$array_name_column <<- paste0(truss$aisc$Type, "--", truss$aisc$EDI_Std_Nomenclature)
      truss$aisc$r_min <<- pmin(truss$aisc$rx, truss$aisc$ry)
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio <<- NA
      for (col in c("Zx", "Sx", "Ix", "Iy", "J", "rts", "ho", "d", "Cw")) {
        truss$aisc[[col]] <<- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(truss$aisc[[col]]))
      }
    }
    
    drop_incomplete <- function() {
    
      # columns every section needs, whatever its type
      core <- c("A", "W", "rx", "ry", "r_min", "Zx", "Sx", "Ix")
      bad <- !complete.cases(truss$aisc[, core])
    
      # open shapes also need the lateral-torsional buckling properties
      ltb <- c("Iy", "J", "d")
      open <- truss$aisc$Type %in% c("WT", "2L", "WShape", "W")
      bad <- bad | (open & !complete.cases(truss$aisc[, ltb]))
    
      # W shapes need two more for Chapter F2
      isW <- truss$aisc$Type %in% c("WShape", "W")
      bad <- bad | (isW & !complete.cases(truss$aisc[, c("rts", "ho")]))
    
      if (any(bad)) {
    
        message("drop_incomplete: removing ", sum(bad),
                " sections with missing values:")
    
        print(truss$aisc[bad, c("Type", "EDI_Std_Nomenclature", core)])
      }
    
      truss$aisc <<- truss$aisc[!bad, ]
    }

    add_t_net <- function() {
      for (i in 1:nrow(truss$aisc)) {
        type <- truss$aisc$Type[i]

        if (type == "2L") {
          truss$aisc$t_net[i] <<- truss$aisc$t[i]          # angle leg
        } else if (type %in% c("WT", "WShape", "W")) {
          truss$aisc$t_net[i] <<- truss$aisc$tf[i]         # flange
        } else if (type %in% c("Rectangle", "Round", "PIPE")) {
          truss$aisc$t_net[i] <<- 0                        # welded, no holes
        }
      }
    }

   Limiting_ratio_function <- function() {

  # create the new column up front so indexed assignment works
  truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_p <<- NA_real_

  for (i in 1:nrow(truss$aisc)) {

    type <- truss$aisc$Type[i]
    E    <- truss$Single_value_constant$E
    Fy   <- truss$Family$Fy[match(type, truss$Family$FamilyName)]

    if (type == "Rectangle") {
      lr <- 1.40 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio[i] <<- max(truss$aisc$`b/tdes`[i] / lr,
                                           truss$aisc$`h/tdes`[i] / lr) - 1

      lp_flange <- 1.12 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      lp_web    <- 2.42 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_p[i] <<- max(truss$aisc$`b/tdes`[i] / lp_flange,
                                             truss$aisc$`h/tdes`[i] / lp_web) - 1

    } else if (type %in% c("Round", "PIPE")) {
      lr <- 0.11 * E / Fy
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio[i] <<- truss$aisc$`D/t`[i] / lr - 1

      lp <- 0.07 * E / Fy
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_p[i] <<- truss$aisc$`D/t`[i] / lp - 1

    } else if (type == "WT") {
      lr_flange <- 0.56 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      lr_stem   <- 0.75 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio[i] <<- max(truss$aisc$`bf/2tf`[i] / lr_flange,
                                           truss$aisc$`D/t`[i]    / lr_stem) - 1

      lp_flange <- 0.38 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      lp_stem   <- 0.84 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_p[i] <<- max(truss$aisc$`bf/2tf`[i] / lp_flange,
                                             truss$aisc$`D/t`[i]    / lp_stem) - 1

    } else if (type == "2L") {
      lr <- 0.45 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio[i] <<- truss$aisc$`b/t`[i] / lr - 1

      lp <- 0.54 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_p[i] <<- truss$aisc$`b/t`[i] / lp - 1

    } else if (type %in% c("WShape", "W")) {
      lr_flange <- 0.56 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      lr_web    <- 1.49 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio[i] <<- max(truss$aisc$`bf/2tf`[i] / lr_flange,
                                           truss$aisc$`h/tw`[i]   / lr_web) - 1

      lp_flange <- 0.38 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      lp_web    <- 3.76 * sqrt(E / Fy)
      truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_p[i] <<- max(truss$aisc$`bf/2tf`[i] / lp_flange,
                                             truss$aisc$`h/tw`[i]   / lp_web) - 1
    }
  }

  truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_test   <<- truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio   <= 0
  truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_p_test <<- truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_p <= 0
   }
   

    drop_failed_ratio <- function() {
      keep <- truss$aisc$Limiting_ratio_test %in% TRUE     # NA counts as failed

      truss$dropped_aisc_Limiting_ratio <<- truss$aisc[!keep, ]
      truss$aisc                        <<- truss$aisc[keep, ]
    }
    
    # CostLevel1: one value per family, copied to every section of that family
    map_cost_level1 <- function() {
      truss$aisc$CostLevel1 <<- as.numeric(
        truss$Family$CostLevel1[match(truss$aisc$Type, truss$Family$FamilyName)]
      )

      miss <- is.na(truss$aisc$CostLevel1)
      if (any(miss))
        message("map_cost_level1: no cost for types: ",
                paste(unique(truss$aisc$Type[miss]), collapse = ", "))
    }

    rename_hss()
    rename_w()
    map_J()
    drop_types()
    add_columns()
    drop_incomplete()
    add_t_net()
    Limiting_ratio_function()
    drop_failed_ratio()
    map_cost_level1()
  }

  populate_bar <- function() {

    # drop the notes rows, make bar number numeric, create empty result columns
    clean_bar <- function() {
      truss$Bar   <<- truss$Bar[!is.na(truss$Bar$FromJoint), ]
      truss$Joint <<- truss$Joint[!is.na(truss$Joint$JointNumber), ]
      truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]] <<- as.numeric(truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]])

      n <- nrow(truss$Bar)
      for (col in c("Length", "cos", "sin", "CrossingWith", "CrossingPoint_x",
                    "CrossingPoint_y", "L1", "L2", "L_b", "EffectiveLength"))
        truss$Bar[[col]] <<- rep(NA_real_, n)
    }

    bar_length <- function() {
      for (i in 1:nrow(truss$Bar)) {
        a <- which(truss$Joint$JointNumber == truss$Bar$FromJoint[i])
        b <- which(truss$Joint$JointNumber == truss$Bar$ToJoint[i])
        dx <- truss$Joint$x_coordinate[b] - truss$Joint$x_coordinate[a]
        dy <- truss$Joint$y_coordinate[b] - truss$Joint$y_coordinate[a]

        truss$Bar$Length[i] <<- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)
        truss$Bar$cos[i]    <<- dx / truss$Bar$Length[i]
        truss$Bar$sin[i]    <<- dy / truss$Bar$Length[i]
      }
    }

    L_crossing_length <- function() {
      diag <- which(truss$Bar$Type == "Diagonal")

      for (i in diag) {
        for (j in diag) {
          if (i == j) next

          a <- which(truss$Joint$JointNumber == truss$Bar$FromJoint[i])
          b <- which(truss$Joint$JointNumber == truss$Bar$ToJoint[i])
          px <- truss$Joint$x_coordinate[a]
          py <- truss$Joint$y_coordinate[a]
          rx <- truss$Joint$x_coordinate[b] - px
          ry <- truss$Joint$y_coordinate[b] - py

          k <- which(truss$Joint$JointNumber == truss$Bar$FromJoint[j])
          m <- which(truss$Joint$JointNumber == truss$Bar$ToJoint[j])
          qx <- truss$Joint$x_coordinate[k]
          qy <- truss$Joint$y_coordinate[k]
          sx <- truss$Joint$x_coordinate[m] - qx
          sy <- truss$Joint$y_coordinate[m] - qy

          d <- rx * sy - ry * sx
          if (d == 0) next

          t <- ((qx - px) * sy - (qy - py) * sx) / d
          u <- ((qx - px) * ry - (qy - py) * rx) / d

          if (t > 0 & t < 1 & u > 0 & u < 1) {
            truss$Bar$CrossingWith[i]    <<- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]][j]
            truss$Bar$CrossingPoint_x[i] <<- px + t * rx
            truss$Bar$CrossingPoint_y[i] <<- py + t * ry
            truss$Bar$L1[i]  <<- t * truss$Bar$Length[i]
            truss$Bar$L2[i]  <<- (1 - t) * truss$Bar$Length[i]
            truss$Bar$L_b[i] <<- max(truss$Bar$L1[i], truss$Bar$L2[i])
          }
        }
      }
    }

    Effective_length_function <- function() {
      truss$Bar$EffectiveLength <<- ifelse(is.na(truss$Bar$L_b),
                                           truss$Bar$Length,
                                           truss$Bar$L_b) * truss$Single_value_constant$K
    }

    clean_bar()
    bar_length()
    L_crossing_length()
    Effective_length_function()
  }

  populate_aisc()
  populate_bar()
  return(truss)
}
```


Constraint 7: valid connection system. Reads pass5 (C5). Creates: g7, allowed (sections x bars x systems)
```{r c7}
webchord_barlist <- function(truss) {

  # "Round + PIPE" -> c("Round", "PIPE")
  list_types <- function(cell) {
    if (is.na(cell) || trimws(cell) == "") return(character(0))
    trimws(strsplit(cell, "+", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  }

  # which sections each bar may use in each system
  allowed <- function() {
    truss$allowed <<- array(FALSE,
      dim = c(nrow(truss$aisc), nrow(truss$Bar), nrow(truss$System)),
      dimnames = list(truss$aisc$array_name_column,
                      truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]],
                      truss$System$System))

    for (i in 1:nrow(truss$System)) {
      chord_ok <- truss$aisc$Type %in% list_types(truss$System$Chord_List[i])
      web_ok   <- truss$aisc$Type %in% list_types(truss$System$Web_List[i])

      for (b in 1:nrow(truss$Bar)) {
        truss$allowed[, b, i] <<- if (truss$Bar$ChordWeb[b] == "Chord") chord_ok else web_ok
      }
    }
  }

  allowed()
  return(truss)
}
```

Structure analysis. Creates: S_e, F_Dy, F_LC1y, F_LC2y, F_SLS1y, F, K, u, stretch, N, R, N_t, N_c, CompTension, r_required, uy_max, check_Rx, check_Ry
```{r structure}
structure_function <- function(truss) {

  key      <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar      <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  joint    <- truss$Joint$JointNumber
  nb       <- nrow(truss$Bar)
  ndof     <- 2 * nrow(truss$Joint)
  lc_names <- c("LC1", "LC2", "SLS1")

  # support flags by DOF number -> free (f) and restrained (r)
  fix <- numeric(ndof)
  fix[truss$Joint$x_dof] <- truss$Joint$x_fix
  fix[truss$Joint$y_dof] <- truss$Joint$y_fix
  free <- which(fix == 0)
  rest <- which(fix == 1)

  # ---------- 6.1, 6.2 self weight ----------
  self_weight <- function() {
    W_e <- matrix(truss$aisc$W, length(key), length(bar), dimnames = list(key, bar))
    L_e <- matrix(truss$Bar$Length, length(key), length(bar), byrow = TRUE,
                  dimnames = list(key, bar))
    truss$S_e <<- W_e * L_e / 12000
  }

  # ---------- 6.3 loads ----------
  PLPL_xy <- function() {
    truss$Joint$PD_x[is.na(truss$Joint$PD_x)] <<- 0
    truss$Joint$PD_y[is.na(truss$Joint$PD_y)] <<- 0
    truss$Joint$PL_x[is.na(truss$Joint$PL_x)] <<- 0
    truss$Joint$PL_y[is.na(truss$Joint$PL_y)] <<- 0

    truss$Joint$FL_x <<- truss$Joint$PL_x
    truss$Joint$FL_y <<- truss$Joint$PL_y
    truss$Joint$FD_x <<- truss$Joint$PD_x

    F_Dy <- matrix(0, length(key), length(joint), dimnames = list(key, joint))
    for (j in 1:nrow(truss$Joint)) {
      bars <- which(truss$Bar$FromJoint == joint[j] | truss$Bar$ToJoint == joint[j])
      F_Dy[, j] <- truss$Joint$PD_y[j] - rowSums(truss$S_e[, bars, drop = FALSE]) / 2
    }
    truss$F_Dy <<- F_Dy

    truss$Joint$FLC1_x  <<- 1.4 * truss$Joint$FD_x
    truss$Joint$FLC2_x  <<- 1.2 * truss$Joint$FD_x + 1.6 * truss$Joint$FL_x
    truss$Joint$FSLS1_x <<- truss$Joint$FD_x + truss$Joint$FL_x

    FL_y_mat <- matrix(truss$Joint$FL_y, length(key), length(joint), byrow = TRUE,
                       dimnames = list(key, joint))
    truss$F_LC1y  <<- 1.4 * F_Dy
    truss$F_LC2y  <<- 1.2 * F_Dy + 1.6 * FL_y_mat
    truss$F_SLS1y <<- F_Dy + FL_y_mat
  }

  # ---------- load vectors by DOF: sections x DOFs x combinations ----------
  load_vectors <- function() {
    truss$F <<- array(0, dim = c(length(key), ndof, length(lc_names)),
                      dimnames = list(key, NULL, lc_names))

    for (j in 1:nrow(truss$Joint)) {
      xd <- truss$Joint$x_dof[j]
      yd <- truss$Joint$y_dof[j]

      truss$F[, xd, "LC1"]  <<- truss$Joint$FLC1_x[j]
      truss$F[, xd, "LC2"]  <<- truss$Joint$FLC2_x[j]
      truss$F[, xd, "SLS1"] <<- truss$Joint$FSLS1_x[j]

      truss$F[, yd, "LC1"]  <<- truss$F_LC1y[, j]
      truss$F[, yd, "LC2"]  <<- truss$F_LC2y[, j]
      truss$F[, yd, "SLS1"] <<- truss$F_SLS1y[, j]
    }
  }

  # ---------- 6.4 stiffness ----------
  stiffness <- function() {
    dof <- c("x_from", "y_from", "x_to", "y_to")
    k_e <- array(NA, dim = c(length(key), nb, 4, 4), dimnames = list(key, bar, dof, dof))

    for (b in 1:nb) {
      v <- c(truss$Bar$cos[b], truss$Bar$sin[b], -truss$Bar$cos[b], -truss$Bar$sin[b])
      coef <- truss$Single_value_constant$E * truss$aisc$A / truss$Bar$Length[b]
      k_e[, b, , ] <- outer(coef, outer(v, v))
    }

    truss$K <<- array(0, dim = c(length(key), ndof, ndof), dimnames = list(key, NULL, NULL))

    for (b in 1:nb) {
      from_row <- match(truss$Bar$FromJoint[b], truss$Joint$JointNumber)
      to_row   <- match(truss$Bar$ToJoint[b],   truss$Joint$JointNumber)
      d <- c(truss$Joint$x_dof[from_row], truss$Joint$y_dof[from_row],
             truss$Joint$x_dof[to_row],   truss$Joint$y_dof[to_row])
      truss$K[, d, d] <<- truss$K[, d, d] + k_e[, b, , ]
    }
  }

  # ---------- 6.5 movements ----------
  solve_u <- function() {
    truss$u <<- array(0, dim = c(length(key), ndof, length(lc_names)),
                      dimnames = list(key, NULL, lc_names))

    for (lc in lc_names) {
      for (s in 1:length(key)) {
        if (anyNA(truss$K[s, free, free])) next        # invalid section stays 0
        truss$u[s, free, lc] <<- solve(truss$K[s, free, free], truss$F[s, free, lc])
      }
    }
  }

  # ---------- 6.6 stretch and axial force ----------
  stretch_N <- function() {
    truss$stretch <<- array(NA, dim = c(length(key), nb, length(lc_names)),
                            dimnames = list(key, bar, lc_names))
    truss$N <<- truss$stretch

    for (b in 1:nb) {
      from_row <- match(truss$Bar$FromJoint[b], truss$Joint$JointNumber)
      to_row   <- match(truss$Bar$ToJoint[b],   truss$Joint$JointNumber)
      xf <- truss$Joint$x_dof[from_row];  yf <- truss$Joint$y_dof[from_row]
      xt <- truss$Joint$x_dof[to_row];    yt <- truss$Joint$y_dof[to_row]

      coef <- truss$Single_value_constant$E * truss$aisc$A / truss$Bar$Length[b]

      for (lc in lc_names) {
        du_x <- truss$u[, xt, lc] - truss$u[, xf, lc]
        du_y <- truss$u[, yt, lc] - truss$u[, yf, lc]

        truss$stretch[, b, lc] <<- truss$Bar$cos[b] * du_x + truss$Bar$sin[b] * du_y
        truss$N[, b, lc]       <<- coef * truss$stretch[, b, lc]
      }
    }
  }

  # ---------- 6.7 support reactions ----------
  reactions <- function() {
    truss$R <<- array(NA, dim = c(length(key), length(rest), length(lc_names)),
                      dimnames = list(key, rest, lc_names))

    for (lc in lc_names) {
      for (s in 1:length(key)) {
        truss$R[s, , lc] <<- truss$K[s, rest, ] %*% truss$u[s, , lc] - truss$F[s, rest, lc]
      }
    }
  }

  # ---------- 6.7 check ----------
  reaction_check <- function() {
    ydofs <- truss$Joint$y_dof
    xdofs <- truss$Joint$x_dof

    truss$check_Ry <<- sapply(lc_names, function(lc)
      rowSums(truss$R[, as.character(intersect(ydofs, rest)), lc, drop = FALSE]) +
      rowSums(truss$F[, ydofs, lc]))

    truss$check_Rx <<- sapply(lc_names, function(lc)
      rowSums(truss$R[, as.character(intersect(xdofs, rest)), lc, drop = FALSE]) +
      rowSums(truss$F[, xdofs, lc]))
  }

  # ---------- 6.8 results passed to the checks ----------
  results <- function() {

    # round so floating-point noise (1e-12) is not read as tension or compression
    N1 <- round(truss$N[, , "LC1"], 8)
    N2 <- round(truss$N[, , "LC2"], 8)

    truss$N_t <<- pmax(N1, N2, 0)
    truss$N_c <<- pmax(-N1, -N2, 0)

    truss$CompTension <<- ifelse(truss$N_c > 0, "Compression",
                          ifelse(truss$N_t > 0, "Tension", "Zero"))

    Lc_mat <- matrix(truss$Bar$EffectiveLength, length(key), nb, byrow = TRUE,
                     dimnames = list(key, bar))
    L_mat  <- matrix(truss$Bar$Length, length(key), nb, byrow = TRUE,
                     dimnames = list(key, bar))

    truss$r_required <<- ifelse(truss$CompTension == "Compression",
                                Lc_mat / truss$Single_value_constant$slender_max_c,
                         ifelse(truss$CompTension == "Tension",
                                L_mat / truss$Single_value_constant$slender_max_t, NA))

    free_y <- intersect(truss$Joint$y_dof, free)
    truss$uy_max <<- apply(abs(truss$u[, free_y, "SLS1", drop = FALSE]), 1, max)
  }

  self_weight()
  PLPL_xy()
  load_vectors()
  stiffness()
  solve_u()
  stretch_N()
  reactions()
  reaction_check()
  results()

  return(truss)
}
```

Constraints 1 and 2: capacity. Needs CompTension, N_t, N_c from structure_function. Creates: aisc capacity columns, phi_Pn_t, Fe, phi_Pn_c, phi_Pn, g_cap
```{r phi_Pn}
phi_Pn_function <- function(truss) {

  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  nb  <- nrow(truss$Bar)

  # constraint 1: tension capacity (one value per section)
  phi_Pn_t_function <- function() {

    truss$Single_value_constant$d_h <<- truss$Single_value_constant$d_b + 1/8

    truss$aisc$n_h <<- truss$Family$n_h[match(truss$aisc$Type, truss$Family$FamilyName)]
    truss$aisc$U   <<- truss$Family$U[match(truss$aisc$Type, truss$Family$FamilyName)]
    truss$aisc$Fy  <<- truss$Family$Fy[match(truss$aisc$Type, truss$Family$FamilyName)]
    truss$aisc$Fu  <<- truss$Family$Fu[match(truss$aisc$Type, truss$Family$FamilyName)]

    truss$aisc$A_n <<- truss$aisc$A - truss$aisc$n_h * truss$Single_value_constant$d_h * truss$aisc$t_net
    truss$aisc$A_e <<- truss$aisc$A_n * truss$aisc$U

    truss$aisc$phi_P_n_y <<- truss$Single_value_constant$phi_ty * truss$aisc$Fy * truss$aisc$A
    truss$aisc$phi_P_n_r <<- truss$Single_value_constant$phi_tr * truss$aisc$Fu * truss$aisc$A_e
    truss$aisc$phi_P_n   <<- pmin(truss$aisc$phi_P_n_r, truss$aisc$phi_P_n_y)

    # same value across bars -> sections x bars
    truss$phi_Pn_t <<- matrix(truss$aisc$phi_P_n, length(key), nb, dimnames = list(key, bar))
  }

  # constraint 2: compression capacity (sections x bars)
  phi_Pn_c_function <- function() {

    Fe <- matrix(NA, length(key), nb, dimnames = list(key, bar))

    for (i in 1:nrow(truss$aisc)) {

      if (truss$aisc$Type[i] %in% c("Rectangle", "Round", "PIPE", "WShape", "W")) {
        Fe[i, ] <- pi^2 * truss$Single_value_constant$E /
                   (truss$Bar$EffectiveLength / truss$aisc$r_min[i])^2

      } else if (truss$aisc$Type[i] %in% c("WT", "2L")) {
        Fex <- pi^2 * truss$Single_value_constant$E /
               (truss$Bar$EffectiveLength / truss$aisc$rx[i])^2

        Fey <- pi^2 * truss$Single_value_constant$E /
               (truss$Bar$EffectiveLength / truss$aisc$ry[i])^2

        Fez <- truss$Single_value_constant$G * truss$aisc$J[i] /
               (truss$aisc$A[i] * truss$aisc$ro[i]^2)

        Fe_FT <- (Fey + Fez) / (2 * truss$aisc$H[i]) *
                 (1 - sqrt(1 - 4 * Fey * Fez * truss$aisc$H[i] / (Fey + Fez)^2))

        Fe[i, ] <- pmin(Fex, Fe_FT)
      }
    }

    family <- sub("--.*$", "", rownames(Fe))
    Fy_row <- truss$Family$Fy[match(family, truss$Family$FamilyName)]
    Fy <- matrix(Fy_row, nrow(Fe), ncol(Fe), dimnames = dimnames(Fe))
    ratio <- Fy / Fe
    Fcr <- ifelse(ratio <= 2.25, 0.658^ratio * Fy, 0.877 * Fe)
    Ag_row <- truss$aisc$A[match(rownames(Fcr), truss$aisc$array_name_column)]
    Ag <- matrix(Ag_row, nrow(Fcr), ncol(Fcr), dimnames = dimnames(Fcr))

    truss$Fe       <<- Fe
    truss$phi_Pn_c <<- truss$Single_value_constant$phi_c * Fcr * Ag
  }

  # phi_c Pn: compression value for compression bars, tension value for tension bars
  phi_Pn_final <- function() {
    truss$phi_Pn <<- ifelse(truss$CompTension == "Compression", truss$phi_Pn_c,
                     ifelse(truss$CompTension == "Tension",     truss$phi_Pn_t, NA))
  }

  # demand / capacity - 1 (<= 0 is OK). Zero bars carry no force, so they pass.
  capacity_check <- function() {
    truss$g_cap <<- ifelse(truss$CompTension == "Compression", truss$N_c / truss$phi_Pn - 1,
                    ifelse(truss$CompTension == "Tension",     truss$N_t / truss$phi_Pn - 1, -1))
  }

  phi_Pn_t_function()
  phi_Pn_c_function()
  phi_Pn_final()
  capacity_check()
  return(truss)
}
```

```{r phi_Mn}
# flexural capacity phi_b Mn per section and bar (kip-in), AISC 360-16 Chapter F
# bending about x (strong axis across the truss plane); WT and 2L flange up, stem in tension
phi_Mn_function <- function(truss) {

  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  nb  <- nrow(truss$Bar)
  E   <- truss$Single_value_constant$E
  Cb  <- truss$Single_value_constant$Cb
  Lb  <- truss$Bar$EffectiveLength                       # unbraced length for LTB, one per bar
  Fy  <- truss$Family$Fy[match(truss$aisc$Type, truss$Family$FamilyName)]
  num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

  Mn <- matrix(NA_real_, length(key), nb, dimnames = list(key, bar))

  for (i in 1:nrow(truss$aisc)) {

    type <- truss$aisc$Type[i]
    fy   <- Fy[i]
    s    <- sqrt(E / fy)
    Zx   <- truss$aisc$Zx[i]
    Sx   <- truss$aisc$Sx[i]
    Mp   <- fy * Zx                                       # F2-1, F7-1, F8-1
    My   <- fy * Sx

    if (type == "Rectangle") {                            # F7
      bt <- num(truss$aisc$`b/tdes`[i])
      ht <- num(truss$aisc$`h/tdes`[i])
      Mn_f <- if (bt <= 1.12 * s) Mp else
              min(Mp, Mp - (Mp - My) * (3.57 * bt * sqrt(fy / E) - 4.0))      # F7-2
      Mn_w <- if (ht <= 2.42 * s) Mp else
              min(Mp, Mp - (Mp - My) * (0.305 * ht * sqrt(fy / E) - 0.738))  # F7-6
      Mn[i, ] <- min(Mp, Mn_f, Mn_w)

    } else if (type %in% c("Round", "PIPE")) {            # F8, no LTB
      Dt <- num(truss$aisc$`D/t`[i])
      Mn[i, ] <- if (Dt <= 0.07 * E / fy) Mp else
                 if (Dt <= 0.31 * E / fy) min(Mp, (0.021 * E / Dt + fy) * Sx) else   # F8-2
                 (0.33 * E / Dt) * Sx                                                # F8-3, F8-4

    } else if (type %in% c("WShape", "W")) {              # F2 (LTB) and F3 (flange)
      ry  <- truss$aisc$ry[i];  J  <- truss$aisc$J[i]
      rts <- truss$aisc$rts[i]; ho <- truss$aisc$ho[i]
      k   <- J / (Sx * ho)                                                   # c = 1
      Lp  <- 1.76 * ry * s                                                   # F2-5
      Lr  <- 1.95 * rts * E / (0.7 * fy) *
             sqrt(k + sqrt(k^2 + 6.76 * (0.7 * fy / E)^2))                   # F2-6
      Fcr <- Cb * pi^2 * E / (Lb / rts)^2 * sqrt(1 + 0.078 * k * (Lb / rts)^2)  # F2-4
      Mn_ltb <- ifelse(Lb <= Lp, Mp,
                ifelse(Lb <= Lr, pmin(Mp, Cb * (Mp - (Mp - 0.7 * My) * (Lb - Lp) / (Lr - Lp))),  # F2-2
                                 pmin(Mp, Fcr * Sx)))                                            # F2-3
      lam <- num(truss$aisc$`bf/2tf`[i]); lp <- 0.38 * s; lr <- 1.0 * s
      kc  <- min(0.76, max(0.35, 4 / sqrt(num(truss$aisc$`h/tw`[i]))))
      Mn_flb <- if (lam <= lp) Mp else
                if (lam <= lr) Mp - (Mp - 0.7 * My) * (lam - lp) / (lr - lp) else   # F3-1
                0.9 * E * kc * Sx / lam^2                                           # F3-2
      Mn[i, ] <- pmin(Mn_ltb, Mn_flb)

    } else if (type %in% c("WT", "2L")) {                 # F9, stem / web legs in tension
      ry <- truss$aisc$ry[i]; Iy <- truss$aisc$Iy[i]
      J  <- truss$aisc$J[i];  d  <- truss$aisc$d[i]
      Mp  <- min(fy * Zx, 1.6 * My)                                          # F9-2
      Lp  <- 1.76 * ry * s                                                   # F9-8
      Lr  <- 1.95 * (E / fy) * sqrt(Iy * J) / Sx * sqrt(2.36 * (fy / E) * d * Sx / J + 1)  # F9-9
      B   <- 2.3 * (d / Lb) * sqrt(Iy / J)                                   # F9-11
      Mcr <- 1.95 * E / Lb * sqrt(Iy * J) * (B + sqrt(1 + B^2))              # F9-10
      Mn_ltb <- ifelse(Lb <= Lp, Mp,
                ifelse(Lb <= Lr, Mp - (Mp - My) * (Lb - Lp) / (Lr - Lp),     # F9-6
                                 pmin(Mcr, Mp)))                             # F9-7
      if (type == "WT") {                                 # F9-14, F9-15, flange in compression
        lam <- num(truss$aisc$`bf/2tf`[i]); lp <- 0.38 * s; lr <- 1.0 * s
        Mn_flb <- if (lam <= lp) Mp else
                  if (lam <= lr) min(1.6 * My, Mp - (Mp - 0.7 * My) * (lam - lp) / (lr - lp)) else
                  0.7 * E * Sx / lam^2
      } else {                                            # 2L outstanding legs, F10-6, F10-7
        lam <- num(truss$aisc$`b/t`[i]); lp <- 0.54 * s; lr <- 0.91 * s
        Mn_flb <- if (lam <= lp) Mp else
                  if (lam <= lr) fy * Sx * (2.43 - 1.72 * lam * sqrt(fy / E)) else
                  (0.71 * E / lam^2) * Sx
      }
      Mn[i, ] <- pmin(Mn_ltb, Mn_flb)
    }
  }

  truss$Mn     <- Mn
  truss$phi_Mn <- truss$Single_value_constant$phi_b * Mn
  return(truss)
}
```


```{r moment_function}
# self-weight moment per bar and the Appendix 8 amplifier B1 for compression bars
moment_function <- function(truss) {
    
      key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
      bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
      nb <- nrow(truss$Bar)
      E <- truss$Single_value_constant$E
      Cm <- truss$Single_value_constant$Cm
      alp <- truss$Single_value_constant$alpha
    
      # 3.1 first-order self-weight moment, kip-in: w cos(theta) L^2 / 8, full bar length
      w_kip_in <- truss$aisc$W / 12000       # lb/ft -> kip/in
      M_sw <- outer(w_kip_in, abs(truss$Bar$cos) * truss$Bar$Length^2 / 8)
      dimnames(M_sw) <- list(key, bar)
    
      # 3.2 Euler load in the plane of bending, kips: pi^2 E Ix / Lc1^2, Lc1 = EffectiveLength
      Pe1 <- outer(pi^2 * E * truss$aisc$Ix, 1 / truss$Bar$EffectiveLength^2)
      dimnames(Pe1) <- list(key, bar)
    
      # 3.3 B1 per combination: compression bars only (negative N); 1 otherwise.
      # A bar at or past its Euler load gets a very large B1, so it is rejected.
      B1_of <- function(N) {
        Pr <- pmax(-N, 0)                    # compression as a positive
        r <- alp * Pr / Pe1
        ifelse(Pr == 0, 1, ifelse(r >= 1, 1e6, pmax(1, Cm / (1 - r))))
      }
    
      B1_LC1 <- B1_of(truss$N_LC1)
      B1_LC2 <- B1_of(truss$N_LC2)
    
      # 3.4 required moments, factored by the dead-load factor of each combination
      truss$M_sw  <- M_sw
      truss$Pe1   <- Pe1
      truss$B1_LC1 <- B1_LC1
      truss$B1_LC2 <- B1_LC2
      truss$Mr_LC1 <- 1.4 * M_sw * B1_LC1
      truss$Mr_LC2 <- 1.2 * M_sw * B1_LC2
    
      return(truss)
    }
```

```{r interaction_function}
# capacity check as AISC 360-16 H1-1a / H1-1b, per load combination, worst of LC1 and LC2
interaction_function <- function(truss) {
    
      g_of <- function(N, Mr) {
        Pr    <- abs(N)                                                  # kips, either sign
        Pc    <- ifelse(N < 0, truss$phi_Pn_c, truss$phi_Pn_t)           # compression or tension capacity
        ratio <- Pr / Pc
        Mc    <- truss$phi_Mn
        ifelse(ratio >= 0.2,
               ratio     + (8 / 9) * (Mr / Mc),                          # H1-1a
               ratio / 2 +           (Mr / Mc)) - 1                      # H1-1b (also covers N = 0)
      }
    
      truss$g_cap_axial <- truss$g_cap                                   # the old axial-only value, kept for Step 2
      truss$g_LC1 <- g_of(truss$N_LC1, truss$Mr_LC1)
      truss$g_LC2 <- g_of(truss$N_LC2, truss$Mr_LC2)
      truss$g_cap <- pmax(truss$g_LC1, truss$g_LC2)
      return(truss)
    }
```

 slenderness: Creates: lambda_c, lambda_t, compression_slenderness, Tension_slenderness
```{r slenderness}
slenderness_function <- function(truss) {

  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]

  # constraint 3: compression bars, uses Lc (EffectiveLength)
  compression_slenderness <- function() {
    truss$lambda_c <<- outer(1 / truss$aisc$r_min, truss$Bar$EffectiveLength)
    dimnames(truss$lambda_c) <<- list(key, bar)

    truss$compression_slenderness <<- ifelse(truss$N_c > 0,
                        truss$lambda_c / truss$Single_value_constant$slender_max_c - 1,
                        -1)
  }

  # constraint 4: tension bars only, uses Length (not EffectiveLength)
  Tension_slenderness <- function() {
    truss$lambda_t <<- outer(1 / truss$aisc$r_min, truss$Bar$Length)
    dimnames(truss$lambda_t) <<- list(key, bar)

    truss$Tension_slenderness <<- ifelse(truss$N_c == 0 & truss$N_t > 0,
                        truss$lambda_t / truss$Single_value_constant$slender_max_t - 1,
                        -1)
  }

  compression_slenderness()
  Tension_slenderness()
  return(truss)
}
```

Constraint 6: deflection. Needs uy_max from structure_function. Creates: delta_allow, deflection
```{r c6}
deflection_function <- function(truss) {

  # allowed deflection: from Single_value_constant if you add it, otherwise span / 180
  if ("delta_allow" %in% names(truss$Single_value_constant)) {
    delta_allow <- truss$Single_value_constant$delta_allow
  } else {
    delta_allow <- (max(truss$Joint$x_coordinate) - min(truss$Joint$x_coordinate)) / 180
  }
  truss$delta_allow <- delta_allow

  # deflection = uy_max / delta_allow - 1  (<= 0 is OK), one value per section
  truss$deflection <- truss$uy_max / delta_allow - 1

  return(truss)
}
```

```{r}
hss_joint_function <- function(truss) {

  key   <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar   <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  joint <- truss$Joint$JointNumber
  ns <- length(key);  nb <- length(bar);  nj <- length(joint)
  E  <- truss$Single_value_constant$E

  is_rect  <- truss$aisc$Type == "Rectangle"
  is_round <- truss$aisc$Type %in% c("Round", "PIPE")
  is_hss   <- is_rect | is_round

  Fy <- truss$Family$Fy[match(truss$aisc$Type, truss$Family$FamilyName)]
  Fu <- truss$Family$Fu[match(truss$aisc$Type, truss$Family$FamilyName)]

  # chord section sizes (NA when the shape does not have that size)
  B  <- ifelse(is_rect,  truss$aisc$B,  NA)
  H  <- ifelse(is_rect,  truss$aisc$Ht, NA)
  D  <- ifelse(is_round, truss$aisc$OD, NA)
  tt <- truss$aisc$tdes

  # web sizes: same section on every bar
  Bb <- B;  Hb <- H;  Db <- D;  tb <- tt;  Fyb <- Fy

  from <- truss$Bar$FromJoint
  to   <- truss$Bar$ToJoint
  role <- truss$Bar$ChordWeb

  hss_joint_check <- function() {

    # ---- per section ----
    g81 <- ifelse(is_rect, pmax(B, H) / tt / 35, D / tt / 50) - 1            # chord wall
    g85 <- pmax(H / B / 2, 0.5 / (H / B), Hb / Bb / 2, 0.5 / (Hb / Bb)) - 1  # aspect ratio (Rectangle)
    g87 <- ifelse(is_rect, Fy / 52,                                          # Rectangle: Fy/Fu waived (A500 Gr. C)
                           pmax(Fy / 52, (Fy / Fu) / 0.8)) - 1               # steel

    # ---- per section and bar: web wall, pushed or pulled ----
    pushed   <- truss$CompTension == "Compression"
    wall_b   <- ifelse(is_rect, pmax(Bb, Hb) / tb, Db / tb)
    lim_push <- ifelse(is_rect, 1.25 * sqrt(E / Fyb), 0.05 * E / Fyb)
    lim_pull <- ifelse(is_rect, 35, 50)
    lim      <- ifelse(pushed, lim_push, lim_pull)
    g82      <- wall_b / lim - 1                                             # sections x bars

    # ---- per joint ----
    g8_joint <- matrix(-1, ns, nj, dimnames = list(key, joint))

    for (j in seq_len(nj)) {
      at     <- which(from == joint[j] | to == joint[j])
      chords <- at[role[at] == "Chord"]
      webs   <- at[role[at] == "Web"]
      if (length(chords) == 0 || length(webs) == 0) next    # joint not checked

      n_web <- length(webs)
      is_K  <- n_web >= 2

      # angle between web and chord (worst pair at this joint)
      cos_t <- abs(outer(truss$Bar$cos[webs], truss$Bar$cos[chords]) +
                   outer(truss$Bar$sin[webs], truss$Bar$sin[chords]))
      theta <- acos(pmin(cos_t, 1)) * 180 / pi
      g86   <- max(30 / theta) - 1

      # web wall: worst web bar at the joint
      g82_j <- apply(g82[, webs, drop = FALSE], 1, max)

      # web size vs chord size
      g83_rect  <- Bb / B - 1
      d_min     <- if (is_K) 0.4 else 0.2          # T/Y limit assumed, check K3.1A
      g83_round <- pmax(Db / D, d_min / (Db / D)) - 1
      g83       <- ifelse(is_rect, g83_rect, g83_round)

      # rectangle width limit
      if (is_K) {
        beta_eff <- n_web * (Bb + Hb) / (4 * B)
        g84 <- 0.35 / beta_eff - 1
      } else {
        g84 <- 0.25 / (Bb / B) - 1                  # T/Y limit assumed, check your sheet
      }

      g8_joint[, j] <- pmax(g81, g82_j, g83, g84, g85, g86, g87, na.rm = TRUE)
    }

    g8_joint[!is_hss, ] <- -1                       # non-HSS sections always pass

    # ---- bar value = worst of its two end joints ----
    g8 <- matrix(-1, ns, nb, dimnames = list(key, bar))
    for (b in seq_len(nb)) {
      jf <- match(from[b], joint)
      jt <- match(to[b],   joint)
      g8[, b] <- pmax(g8_joint[, jf], g8_joint[, jt])
    }

    truss$g8_joint <<- g8_joint
    truss$g8       <<- g8
  }

  hss_joint_check()
  return(truss)
}
```



Stack everything. Creates: arr (sections x bars x layers), g_max and feasible (sections x bars x systems). NOTE: now has a plot argument so the loop does not draw every iteration.
```{r stack}
stack_function <- function(truss, plot = TRUE) {

  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  sys <- dimnames(truss$allowed)[[3]]

  group_col   <- "Group"            # name of the group column in the Bar sheet
  hss_systems <- c("S1", "S2")      # welded HSS systems, C8 applies here only

  stack_arr <- function() {
    layers <- c("Fe", "phi_Pn", "N_t", "N_c",
                "compression_slenderness", "Tension_slenderness", "g_cap", "deflection", "g8")

    truss$arr <<- array(NA, dim = c(length(key), length(bar), length(layers)),
                        dimnames = list(key, bar, layers))

    truss$arr[, , "Fe"]                      <<- truss$Fe
    truss$arr[, , "phi_Pn"]                  <<- truss$phi_Pn
    truss$arr[, , "N_t"]                     <<- truss$N_t
    truss$arr[, , "N_c"]                     <<- truss$N_c
    truss$arr[, , "compression_slenderness"] <<- truss$compression_slenderness
    truss$arr[, , "Tension_slenderness"]     <<- truss$Tension_slenderness
    truss$arr[, , "g_cap"]                   <<- truss$g_cap
    truss$arr[, , "g8"]                      <<- truss$g8

    truss$deflection_mat <<- matrix(truss$deflection, length(key), length(bar),
                                    dimnames = list(key, bar))
    truss$arr[, , "deflection"]              <<- truss$deflection_mat
  }

  link_constraints <- function() {
    truss$g_max <<- array(NA, dim = c(length(key), length(bar), length(sys)),
                          dimnames = list(key, bar, sys))

    for (i in seq_along(sys)) {
      g_system <- ifelse(truss$allowed[, , i], -1, 1)
      g8_sys   <- if (sys[i] %in% hss_systems) truss$g8 else -1     # S3-S5: g8 = -1

      truss$g_max[, , i] <<- pmax(truss$compression_slenderness,
                                  truss$Tension_slenderness,
                                  truss$g_cap,
                                  truss$deflection_mat,
                                  g8_sys,
                                  g_system)
    }

    truss$feasible <<- !is.na(truss$g_max) & truss$g_max <= 0
  }

  group_filter <- function() {

    if (!group_col %in% names(truss$Bar))
      stop("group_filter: column '", group_col, "' not found in truss$Bar")

    grp <- as.character(truss$Bar[[group_col]])
    empty <- is.na(grp) | trimws(grp) == ""
    grp[empty] <- paste0("solo_", bar[empty])

    truss$feasible_group <<- truss$feasible

    for (g in unique(grp)) {
      cols <- which(grp == g)

      for (i in seq_along(sys)) {
        ok <- apply(truss$feasible[, cols, i, drop = FALSE], 1, all)
        truss$feasible_group[, cols, i] <<- matrix(ok, length(key), length(cols))
      }
    }
  }

  plot_stack <- function() {
    op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
    on.exit(par(op))

    cnt <- apply(truss$feasible_group, c(2, 3), sum)
    image(x = 1:nrow(cnt), y = 1:ncol(cnt), z = cnt,
          col = hcl.colors(50, "YlGnBu", rev = TRUE),
          axes = FALSE, xlab = "Bar", ylab = "System",
          main = "Feasible sections per bar and system (grouped)")
    axis(1, at = 1:nrow(cnt), labels = rownames(cnt))
    axis(2, at = 1:ncol(cnt), labels = colnames(cnt), las = 1)
    text(rep(1:nrow(cnt), ncol(cnt)), rep(1:ncol(cnt), each = nrow(cnt)),
         labels = as.vector(cnt), cex = 0.7)
    box()

    lay  <- c("compression_slenderness", "Tension_slenderness", "g_cap", "deflection", "g8")
    viol <- sapply(lay, function(l) apply(truss$arr[, , l] > 0, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE))
    image(x = 1:nrow(viol), y = 1:ncol(viol), z = viol, zlim = c(0, 1),
          col = hcl.colors(50, "Reds", rev = TRUE),
          axes = FALSE, xlab = "Bar", ylab = "Constraint",
          main = "Share of sections violating")
    axis(1, at = 1:nrow(viol), labels = rownames(viol))
    axis(2, at = 1:ncol(viol), labels = colnames(viol), las = 1, cex.axis = 0.6)
    text(rep(1:nrow(viol), ncol(viol)), rep(1:ncol(viol), each = nrow(viol)),
         labels = round(as.vector(viol), 2), cex = 0.7)
    box()
  }

  stack_arr()
  link_constraints()
  group_filter()
  if (plot) plot_stack()
  return(truss)
}
```

```{r}
funnel_function <- function(truss) {

  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  sys <- dimnames(truss$allowed)[[3]]

  hss_systems <- c("S1", "S2")      # C8 applies here only
  layers <- c("compression_slenderness", "Tension_slenderness",
              "g_cap", "deflection", "g8")
  stages <- c("allowed", layers, "group")

  # survivors after each stage: stages x bars x systems
  f <- array(NA, dim = c(length(stages), length(bar), length(sys)),
             dimnames = list(stages, bar, sys))

  for (i in seq_along(sys)) {
    ok <- truss$allowed[, , i]
    f["allowed", , i] <- colSums(ok)

    for (l in layers) {
      if (!(l == "g8" && !(sys[i] %in% hss_systems))) {   # g8 skipped in S3-S5
        g  <- truss$arr[, , l]
        ok <- ok & !is.na(g) & g <= 0                      # NA counts as failed
      }
      f[l, , i] <- colSums(ok)
    }

    f["group", , i] <- colSums(truss$feasible_group[, , i])
  }
  truss$funnel <- f

  # ---------- plot: one panel per system, one grey line per bar, red = average ----------
  op <- par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(8, 4, 3, 1))
  on.exit(par(op))

  for (i in seq_along(sys)) {
    matplot(f[, , i], type = "l", lty = 1, col = "grey70", xaxt = "n",
            xlab = "", ylab = "Sections remaining", main = paste("Funnel,", sys[i]),
            ylim = c(0, max(f)))
    lines(rowMeans(f[, , i]), col = "red", lwd = 3)
    axis(1, at = seq_along(stages), labels = stages, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.7)
  }

  return(truss)
}

```


```{r}
cost_function <- function(truss) {

  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  sys <- dimnames(truss$feasible_group)[[3]]

  group_col <- "Group"                 # same group column as stack_function

  # ---------- cost of every section on every bar (sections x bars) ----------
  cost_matrix <- function() {
    weight_lb <- outer(truss$aisc$W, truss$Bar$Length) / 12       # lb/ft * in / 12
    cost <- weight_lb * truss$aisc$CostLevel1                     # price per lb, per section row
    dimnames(cost) <- list(key, bar)
    truss$cost <<- cost
  }

  # ---------- cheapest feasible section per group and system ----------
  select_cheapest <- function() {

    grp <- as.character(truss$Bar[[group_col]])
    empty <- is.na(grp) | trimws(grp) == ""
    grp[empty] <- paste0("solo_", bar[empty])

    out <- list()

    for (i in seq_along(sys)) {
      for (g in unique(grp)) {
        cols <- which(grp == g)

        ok <- truss$feasible_group[, cols[1], i]                  # same for every bar in the group
        group_cost <- rowSums(truss$cost[, cols, drop = FALSE])   # group shares one section
        group_cost[!ok | is.na(group_cost)] <- Inf

        best <- which.min(group_cost)
        found <- is.finite(group_cost[best])

        out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          System  = sys[i],
          Group   = g,
          Bars    = paste(bar[cols], collapse = ","),
          Section = if (found) key[best] else NA_character_,
          Cost    = if (found) group_cost[best] else NA_real_,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }

    truss$selection <<- do.call(rbind, out)

    # total per system; NA if any group has no feasible section
    truss$total_cost <<- sapply(sys, function(s) {
      x <- truss$selection$Cost[truss$selection$System == s]
      if (anyNA(x)) NA_real_ else sum(x)
    })
  }

  cost_matrix()
  select_cheapest()
  return(truss)
}

```

NEW: mixed-section analysis with grouping inside the loop.

analyze_design: analysis of ONE design, each bar has its own section (bars in a group share one).
```{r analyze_design}
analyze_design <- function(truss, sec_bar) {
  lc_names <- c("LC1", "LC2", "SLS1")
  nb   <- nrow(truss$Bar)
  nj   <- nrow(truss$Joint)
  ndof <- 2 * nj
  E    <- truss$Single_value_constant$E
  L    <- truss$Bar$Length

  A_b <- truss$aisc$A[sec_bar]
  W_b <- truss$aisc$W[sec_bar]
  S_b <- W_b * L / 12000                               # self weight per bar

  from_row <- match(truss$Bar$FromJoint, truss$Joint$JointNumber)
  to_row   <- match(truss$Bar$ToJoint,   truss$Joint$JointNumber)
  xd <- truss$Joint$x_dof
  yd <- truss$Joint$y_dof

  fix <- numeric(ndof)
  fix[xd] <- truss$Joint$x_fix
  fix[yd] <- truss$Joint$y_fix
  free <- which(fix == 0)

  # self weight split half to each end joint
  Sj <- numeric(nj)
  for (b in 1:nb) {
    Sj[from_row[b]] <- Sj[from_row[b]] + S_b[b] / 2
    Sj[to_row[b]]   <- Sj[to_row[b]]   + S_b[b] / 2
  }
  FD_y <- truss$Joint$PD_y - Sj
  FD_x <- truss$Joint$PD_x
  FL_x <- truss$Joint$PL_x
  FL_y <- truss$Joint$PL_y

  F <- matrix(0, ndof, 3, dimnames = list(NULL, lc_names))
  F[xd, "LC1"]  <- 1.4 * FD_x
  F[xd, "LC2"]  <- 1.2 * FD_x + 1.6 * FL_x
  F[xd, "SLS1"] <- FD_x + FL_x
  F[yd, "LC1"]  <- 1.4 * FD_y
  F[yd, "LC2"]  <- 1.2 * FD_y + 1.6 * FL_y
  F[yd, "SLS1"] <- FD_y + FL_y

  # stiffness with each bar's own area
  coef <- E * A_b / L
  K <- matrix(0, ndof, ndof)
  for (b in 1:nb) {
    v <- c(truss$Bar$cos[b], truss$Bar$sin[b], -truss$Bar$cos[b], -truss$Bar$sin[b])
    d <- c(xd[from_row[b]], yd[from_row[b]], xd[to_row[b]], yd[to_row[b]])
    K[d, d] <- K[d, d] + coef[b] * outer(v, v)
  }

  u <- matrix(0, ndof, 3, dimnames = list(NULL, lc_names))
  u[free, ] <- solve(K[free, free], F[free, ])

  N <- matrix(NA, nb, 3, dimnames = list(NULL, lc_names))
  for (b in 1:nb) {
    for (lc in lc_names) {
      du_x <- u[xd[to_row[b]], lc] - u[xd[from_row[b]], lc]
      du_y <- u[yd[to_row[b]], lc] - u[yd[from_row[b]], lc]
      N[b, lc] <- coef[b] * (truss$Bar$cos[b] * du_x + truss$Bar$sin[b] * du_y)
    }
  }

  list(N = N,
       uy_max = max(abs(u[intersect(yd, free), "SLS1"])))
}
```

set_demands, evaluate_design, design_loop (FIXED: a group with no feasible section is "stuck", never "converged")
```{r design_loop}
# ---- put the real demands into the section x bar matrices the checks expect ----
set_demands <- function(truss, an) {
  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  rep_row <- function(v) matrix(v, length(key), length(bar), byrow = TRUE,
                                dimnames = list(key, bar))

  N1 <- round(an$N[, "LC1"], 8)
  N2 <- round(an$N[, "LC2"], 8)
  Nt <- pmax(N1, N2, 0)
  Nc <- pmax(-N1, -N2, 0)
  truss$N_LC1 <- rep_row(N1)  # signed: + tension, - compression

  truss$N_LC2 <- rep_row(N2)

  truss$N_t <- rep_row(Nt)
  truss$N_c <- rep_row(Nc)
  truss$CompTension <- ifelse(truss$N_c > 0, "Compression",
                       ifelse(truss$N_t > 0, "Tension", "Zero"))

  # deflection is a whole-design check, handled in the loop, so neutralise it here
  truss$uy_max <- setNames(rep(0, length(key)), key)
  truss
}

# ---- run all the per-section checks against the current demands ----
evaluate_design <- function(truss, an) {
  truss <- set_demands(truss, an)
  truss <- phi_Pn_function(truss)
  truss <- phi_Mn_function(truss) 
  truss <- moment_function(truss)
  truss <- interaction_function(truss)  
  truss <- slenderness_function(truss)
  truss <- deflection_function(truss)
  truss <- hss_joint_function(truss)
  truss <- stack_function(truss, plot = FALSE)
  truss <- cost_function(truss)
  truss
}

# ---- the loop: sections are chosen per group, and the analysis sees them ----
# start = named vector (group -> section) or NULL (use the uniform-pipeline result)
# quiet = TRUE turns off messages (used by multi_start)
design_loop <- function(truss, system = "S1", start = NULL, max_iter = 30,
                        defl_bump = 1.10, quiet = FALSE) {

  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]

  grp <- as.character(truss$Bar$Group)
  empty <- is.na(grp) | trimws(grp) == ""
  grp[empty] <- paste0("solo_", bar[empty])
  groups <- unique(grp)

  delta_allow <- deflection_function(truss)$delta_allow

  if (!is.null(start)) {
    sec_grp <- start[groups]                          # given / random start
  } else {
    sel <- truss$selection[truss$selection$System == system, ]
    sec_grp <- setNames(sel$Section[match(groups, sel$Group)], groups)
  }
  for (g in groups[is.na(sec_grp)]) {                 # fallback: heaviest allowed section
    cols <- which(grp == g)
    ok <- which(truss$allowed[, cols[1], system])
    if (length(ok) == 0) stop("group ", g, " has no allowed section in ", system)
    sec_grp[g] <- key[ok[which.max(truss$aisc$A[ok])]]
  }

  A_min        <- setNames(rep(0, length(groups)), groups)  # raised if deflection fails
  seen         <- character(0)
  converged    <- FALSE
  stuck        <- FALSE
  stuck_groups <- character(0)
  path <- list()                                         # design at every iteration
  tr <- NULL
  an <- NULL

  for (it in 1:max_iter) {

    sec_bar <- match(sec_grp[grp], key)
    an <- analyze_design(truss, sec_bar)
    path[[it]] <- sec_grp

    defl_ok <- an$uy_max <= delta_allow
    if (!defl_ok)
      A_min <- pmax(A_min, defl_bump * truss$aisc$A[match(sec_grp, key)])

    tr <- evaluate_design(truss, an)

    new_sec <- sec_grp
    stuck_groups <- character(0)                      # reset every iteration
    for (g in groups) {
      cols <- which(grp == g)
      ok   <- tr$feasible_group[, cols[1], system] & tr$aisc$A >= A_min[g]
      gc   <- rowSums(tr$cost[, cols, drop = FALSE])
      gc[!ok | is.na(gc)] <- Inf
      best <- which.min(gc)
      if (is.finite(gc[best])) {
        new_sec[g] <- key[best]
      } else {
        stuck_groups <- c(stuck_groups, g)            # no feasible section for this group
        if (!quiet) message("iter ", it, ": group ", g,
                            " has no feasible section, kept current")
      }
    }
    stuck <- length(stuck_groups) > 0

    if (!quiet)
      message("iter ", it, ": ", sum(new_sec != sec_grp), " groups changed, uy_max = ",
              round(an$uy_max, 3), " (allow ", round(delta_allow, 3), ")",
              if (stuck) paste0(", STUCK: ", paste(stuck_groups, collapse = ",")) else "")

    # true convergence: nothing changes, deflection passes, no group stuck
    if (all(new_sec == sec_grp) && defl_ok && !stuck) { converged <- TRUE; break }

    # nothing can move and something is stuck: stop, this design is infeasible
    if (all(new_sec == sec_grp) && stuck) {
      if (!quiet) warning("stuck groups: ", paste(stuck_groups, collapse = ","),
                          " have no feasible section, stopping")
      break
    }

    tag <- paste(new_sec, collapse = "|")
    if (tag %in% seen) { if (!quiet) warning("design is cycling, stopping"); break }
    seen    <- c(seen, tag)
    sec_grp <- new_sec
  }

  if (!converged && !quiet) warning("did not converge for ", system)

  total <- sum(sapply(groups, function(g) {
    cols <- which(grp == g)
    sum(tr$cost[sec_grp[g], cols])
  }))

  list(system = system, section = sec_grp, converged = converged,
       iterations = it, analysis = an, total_cost = total, path = path,
       stuck = stuck, stuck_groups = stuck_groups)
}
```

group_demands and verify_design
```{r verify}
# ---- governing demands per group from the mixed analysis ----
group_demands <- function(truss, an, sec_grp) {
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  grp <- as.character(truss$Bar$Group)
  empty <- is.na(grp) | trimws(grp) == ""
  grp[empty] <- paste0("solo_", bar[empty])

  Nt <- pmax(round(an$N[, "LC1"], 8), round(an$N[, "LC2"], 8), 0)
  Nc <- pmax(-round(an$N[, "LC1"], 8), -round(an$N[, "LC2"], 8), 0)

  do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(grp), function(g) {
    cols <- which(grp == g)
    data.frame(Group = g,
               Bars = paste(bar[cols], collapse = ","),
               Section = unname(sec_grp[g]),
               N_t_gov = max(Nt[cols]),
               N_t_bar = bar[cols][which.max(Nt[cols])],
               N_c_gov = max(Nc[cols]),
               N_c_bar = bar[cols][which.max(Nc[cols])],
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

# ---- final check of a converged design ----
verify_design <- function(truss, d) {
  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  grp <- as.character(truss$Bar$Group)
  empty <- is.na(grp) | trimws(grp) == ""
  grp[empty] <- paste0("solo_", bar[empty])

  sec_bar <- match(d$section[grp], key)
  an <- analyze_design(truss, sec_bar)
  tr <- evaluate_design(truss, an)

  g_bar <- sapply(seq_along(bar), function(b) tr$g_max[sec_bar[b], b, d$system])
  delta_allow <- deflection_function(truss)$delta_allow

  list(bars_ok = all(g_bar <= 0),
       g_bar = setNames(g_bar, bar),
       deflection_ok = an$uy_max <= delta_allow,
       uy_max = an$uy_max,
       groups = group_demands(truss, an, d$section))
}
```

Size of the search space (sections allowed per group, and the product)
```{r space}
space_size <- function(truss, system) {
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]
  grp <- as.character(truss$Bar$Group)
  empty <- is.na(grp) | trimws(grp) == ""
  grp[empty] <- paste0("solo_", bar[empty])
  groups <- unique(grp)

  n_allowed <- sapply(groups, function(g) {
    cols <- which(grp == g)
    sum(truss$allowed[, cols[1], system])
  })
  list(per_group = n_allowed, total = prod(as.numeric(n_allowed)))
}
```

Multi-start search: run the loop from many starting designs, keep the cheapest converged one
```{r multi_start}
multi_start <- function(truss, system = "S1", n_starts = 30, seed = 1,
                        defl_bump = 1.10, max_iter = 30) {
  set.seed(seed)
  key <- truss$aisc$array_name_column
  bar <- truss$Bar[["Bar Number"]]

  grp <- as.character(truss$Bar$Group)
  empty <- is.na(grp) | trimws(grp) == ""
  grp[empty] <- paste0("solo_", bar[empty])
  groups <- unique(grp)

  random_start <- function() {
    setNames(sapply(groups, function(g) {
      cols <- which(grp == g)
      ok <- which(truss$allowed[, cols[1], system])
      key[ok[sample.int(length(ok), 1)]]
    }), groups)
  }

  # start 1 = the uniform-pipeline start (NULL), the rest are random
  starts  <- c(list(NULL), replicate(n_starts - 1, random_start(), simplify = FALSE))
  results <- lapply(seq_along(starts), function(k) {
    message("system ", system, ": start ", k, " of ", n_starts)
    tryCatch(suppressWarnings(design_loop(truss, system, start = starts[[k]],
                                          max_iter = max_iter, defl_bump = defl_bump,
                                          quiet = TRUE)),
             error = function(e) NULL)
  })

  tab <- data.frame(
    start      = seq_along(results),
    converged  = sapply(results, function(r) !is.null(r) && r$converged),
    total_cost = sapply(results, function(r) if (is.null(r)) NA_real_ else r$total_cost),
    iterations = sapply(results, function(r) if (is.null(r)) NA_integer_ else r$iterations),
    design     = sapply(results, function(r)
                   if (is.null(r)) NA_character_ else paste(r$section, collapse = "|")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  good <- which(tab$converged)
  if (length(good) == 0) stop("no start converged for ", system)
  best <- good[which.min(tab$total_cost[good])]

  # distinct converged designs, cheapest first, with how many starts reached each
  distinct <- aggregate(start ~ design + total_cost, data = tab[good, ], FUN = length)
  names(distinct)[3] <- "times_found"
  distinct <- distinct[order(distinct$total_cost), ]

  list(best = results[[best]], table = tab, distinct = distinct, results = results)
}
```

Run: first check the size of the search space, then the multi-start for every system
```{r run_loop}
sys <- dimnames(truss$allowed)[[3]]

# size of the search space per system
lapply(sys, function(s) space_size(truss, s))

# try n_starts <- 5 first to time it, then raise it
n_starts  <- 100
defl_bump <- 1.10     # deflection bump: areas raised by this factor when the sag is too big
max_iter  <- 50

# multi_start stops with an error if no start converges, so catch it per system
ms <- lapply(sys, function(s)
  tryCatch(multi_start(truss, s, n_starts = n_starts,
                       defl_bump = defl_bump, max_iter = max_iter),
           error = function(e) { message(s, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL }))
names(ms) <- sys

ran <- !sapply(ms, is.null)

# best design per system (only systems where something converged)
sapply(ms[ran], function(m) m$best$total_cost)

# verify the winners from scratch (every bar + deflection)
checks <- lapply(ms[ran], function(m) verify_design(truss, m$best))
sapply(checks, function(x) x$bars_ok && x$deflection_ok)
```

```{r}

show_starts <- function(m, initial = FALSE) {
  groups <- names(m$best$section)

  pick <- function(r) {
    if (is.null(r)) return(rep(NA_character_, length(groups)))   # crashed start
    v <- if (initial) r$path[[1]] else r$section                 # first or final design
    unname(v[groups])
  }

  mat <- t(sapply(m$results, pick))
  colnames(mat) <- groups

  data.frame(
    start      = seq_along(m$results),
    converged  = m$table$converged,
    total_cost = m$table$total_cost,
    mat,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

initial_S1 <- show_starts(ms$S1, initial = TRUE)    # where each start began
```

```{r}
)
design_table                                   # every distinct design, most common first

mode_design <- unlist(conv[match(design_table$design[1], conv$design), groups])
mode_design                                    # the mode design, one section per group

# ---- B) mode of each group (each column separately) ----
mode_by_group <- data.frame(
  Group        = groups,
  mode_section = sapply(groups, function(g) stat_mode(conv[[g]])),
  share        = sapply(groups, function(g) round(mean(conv[[g]] == stat_mode(conv[[g]])), 2)),
  row.names    = NULL
)
mode_by_group
```
